Plan and deliver multimedia content for university events, with organized files for team collaboration.

Led requirements and stakeholder coordination for a PHP/MySQL document system covering 32 city departments. Contributed routing, digital signatures and an admin dashboard.

stack.note: Items with an icon show as logos in their own colours; color is the brand colour used for the hover glow. mono: true is for single-colour logos, drawn in white (black in light mode). pale: true darkens a light brand colour in light mode so it stays visible. Items without an icon (or plain strings) show as text tags, for skills without a logo. href links each item to a page explaining it, and description is the one-sentence tooltip shown on hover and keyboard focus. Logos are saved in assets/icons/stack/ (sources and licences in CREDITS.txt there). The GitHub graph reads a saved snapshot, refreshed daily by .github/workflows/github-snapshot.yml (or by hand with: node scripts/update-github-snapshot.mjs). It shows one circular dot per day in week columns for the complete saved yearly snapshot.
